1454  @dataclass
1455  class KVCacheTensor:
1456      """A class for specifying how the workers should initialize the KV cache.
1457  
1458      Placement of a set of same-shaped layers in the KV cache allocation.
1459      Layer ``layers[l]``'s page for block ``b`` starts at
1460      ``offset + l * layer_stride + b * block_stride`` bytes into the backing
1461      allocation of ``size`` bytes. Layer-outermost layouts give each layer a
1462      contiguous region (``layer_stride = page * num_blocks``,
1463      ``block_stride = page``); block-outermost layouts make each block a
1464      block of all layers' pages (``layer_stride = page``, ``block_stride`` =
1465      the packed block). Tensors whose address ranges overlap
1466      alias the same bytes: cache groups overlay each other, which is sound
1467      because a block ID is owned by one group at a time.
1468      """
1469  
1470      size: int  # total size of the backing allocation in bytes
1471      layers: list[str]  # layer names in L order
1472      layer_stride: int
1473      block_stride: int
1474      offset: int = 0  # byte offset of layers[0]'s block 0
1475      host_resident: bool = False

574  def _get_kv_cache_bytes_per_block(
 575      kv_cache_groups: list[KVCacheGroupSpec], layout: KVCacheLayout
 576  ) -> int:
 577      """Return the largest cache group's bytes per block."""
 578      if not layout.is_block_outermost:
 579          # Each layer's block stride is its own padded page.
 580          return max(
 581              sum(
 582                  _get_layer_block_stride(_get_per_layer_spec(group, layer_name))
 583                  for layer_name in group.layer_names
 584              )
 585              for group in kv_cache_groups
 586          )
 587      bytes_per_block = max(
 588          sum(
 589              _get_per_layer_spec(group, layer_name).page_size_bytes
 590              for layer_name in group.layer_names
 591          )
 592          for group in kv_cache_groups
 593      )
 594      assert bytes_per_block > 0
 595      alignments = [
 596          group.kv_cache_spec.page_size_bytes
 597          for group in kv_cache_groups
 598          if isinstance(group.kv_cache_spec, HiSparseHotSpec)
 599      ]
 600      alignments.extend(
 601          _get_per_layer_spec(group, layer_name).get_block_stride_alignment()
 602          for group in kv_cache_groups
 603          for layer_name in group.layer_names
 604      )
 605      return round_up(bytes_per_block, math.lcm(*alignments))

1789      def _update_after_schedule(self, scheduler_output: SchedulerOutput) -> None:
1790          # Advance the number of computed tokens for the request AFTER
1791          # the request is scheduled.
1792          # 1. The scheduler_output of the current step has to include the
1793          #    original number of scheduled tokens to determine input IDs.
1794          # 2. Advance the number of computed tokens here allowing us to
1795          #    schedule the prefill request again immediately in the next
1796          #    scheduling step.
1797          # 3. If some tokens (e.g. spec tokens) are rejected later, the number of
1798          #    computed tokens will be adjusted in update_from_output.
1799          num_scheduled_tokens = scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens
1800          for req_id, num_scheduled_token in num_scheduled_tokens.items():
1801              request = self.requests[req_id]
1802              request.num_computed_tokens += num_scheduled_token
1803              request.num_in_flight_tokens += num_scheduled_token
1804              if self.defer_block_free:
1805                  # Record the in-flight step, to fence deferred block freeing.

 753          """Touch a block increases its reference count by 1, and may remove
 754          the block from the free queue. This is used when a block is hit by
 755          another request with the same prefix.
 756  
 757          Args:
 758              blocks: A list of blocks to touch.
 759  
 760          """

 762              if block.is_null:
 763                  continue
 764              # ref_cnt=0 means this block is in the free list (i.e. eviction
 765              # candidate), so remove it.
 766              if block.ref_cnt == 0:
 767                  self.free_block_queue.remove(block)
 768              block.ref_cnt += 1

 770                  self.metrics_collector.on_block_accessed(block)
 771

 773          """Return whether a block can be mutated by its sole owner."""
 774          return not block.is_null and block.ref_cnt == 1 and block.block_hash is None
